Create server for dv.reportrate module

Source: R/mod_report_rates.R
report_rates_server.Rd

Create server for dv.reportrate module

Usage

report_rates_server(
  module_id,
  dataset_list,
  dm_dataset_name,
  ds_dataset_name,
  ae_dataset_name,
  subjid_var = REPORT_RATES$DEFAULTS$SUBJID,
  tooltip_decimal_places = REPORT_RATES$DEFAULTS$TT_DECIMAL_PLACES,
  disposition_events,
  adverse_events,
  grouping_vars = list(choices = NULL, default_choice = NULL),
  x_step_size_list = list(days = REPORT_RATES$DEFAULTS$STEPSIZE_DAYS, weeks =
    REPORT_RATES$DEFAULTS$STEPSIZE_WEEKS, months = REPORT_RATES$DEFAULTS$STEPSIZE_MONTHS)
)

Arguments

module_id

[character(1)]

A unique ID string to create a namespace. Must match the ID provided to report_rates_ui()

dataset_list

[shiny::reactive(list(data.frame))]

A reactive list of named datasets. Usually obtained from module manager.

dm_dataset_name

[character(1)]

Name of the demographics dataset in the module manager.

ds_dataset_name

[character(1)]

Name of the disposition dataset in the module manager.

ae_dataset_name

[character(1)]

Name of the adverse-event dataset in the module manager.

subjid_var

[character(1)]

Character name of the unique subject identifier column in all datasets (default is USUBJID). Must be a single value.

tooltip_decimal_places

[integer(1)]

Number of decimal places to round the value shown in the hovertext. Defaults to 3L.

disposition_events

[list]

Named list specifying variables and values used to define entry and exit events in the disposition dataset. Composed of:

  • event_var [character(1)]

    Name of the variable that contains the description of the event. Defaults to "DSDECOD".

  • date_var [character(1)]

    Name of the variable containing the date of the event. Defaults to "DSSTDTC".

  • day_var [character(1)]

    Name of the variable containing the study day of the event. Defaults to "DSSTDY".

  • entry_vals [character(1+)]

    Character vector of values defining which values out of var should be entry events. Defaults to c("RANDOMIZED").

  • exit_vals [character(1+)]

    Character vector of values defining which values out of var should be exit events. Defaults to c("COMPLETED", "WITHDRAWAL BY SUBJECT", "DEATH").

adverse_events

[list]

Named list specifying the variables that define the date and study day of adverse event occurrence. Composed of:

  • date_var [character(1)]

    Name of the variable containing the date of the event. Defaults to "AESTDTC".

  • day_var [character(1)]

    Name of the variable containing the study day of the event. Defaults to "AESTDY".

grouping_vars

[list]

Named list specifying grouping options for the plot. Composed of:

  • choices [character(1+) | NULL]

    Character vector of variable names out of the demographics dataset, specifying which variables are available for grouping. If provided, only these variables can be selected. Defaults to NULL, meaning all factor variables from the demographics dataset will be available for grouping.

  • default_choice [character(1) | NULL]

    Character specifying the default grouping variable to be used when starting the app. Defaults to NULL, meaning no variable is selected for grouping by default.

x_step_size_list

[list]

Controls the spacing of tick marks on the plot’s x-axis. This affects only the appearance of the axis it does not change the time intervals used to calculate rates, the bin size, or the visible x-axis range. Composed of:

  • days [integer(1) | NULL]

    Tick-mark interval, in study days, when Time alignment is By study day. Defaults to 50L.

  • weeks [integer(1) | NULL]

    Tick-mark interval, in weeks, when Time alignment is By study day and Bin size is Week. Defaults to 2L.

  • months [integer(1) | NULL]

    Tick-mark interval, in months, when Time alignment is By study day and Bin size is Month. Defaults to 1L.
